title: Citeck Record Permission Settings
description: Structural schema of a record permission-settings artifact (emodel/permission-settings). Hand-authored for COREDEV-420 P1 task 10: unlike the journal, the action and the type permissions, this kind ships no schema in ecos-idea-plugin. Field set taken from PermissionSettingsDto (ecos-model) and the plugin template model/permission-settings/template.yml.ft.

id.description: Unique id of the settings record

recordRef.description: The record these permissions are granted ON, e.g. eproc/bpmn-def@my-process

inherit.description: Whether the record also inherits the permissions computed by its type

version.description: Settings version. The platform IGNORES an update whose version is not greater than the stored one, so it is bumped by the deploy, not by the model.

settings.description: Grants. Each entry gives the listed permissions to the listed authorities/roles.

authorities.description: Group or user names, e.g. GROUP_EVERYONE, GROUP_bp-manager, ivanov

roles.description: Role ids of the record's type
